question: Which team emerged victorious, defeating Nepal 54-36, to claim the inaugural men’s Kho-Kho World Cup title in New Delhi on 19 January 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Indian men’s team** etched their name in history by becoming the winners of the **inaugural Kho-Kho World Cup**. The final match took place on **19 January 2025** at the **Indira Gandhi (IGI) Indoor Stadium** in **New Delhi**.
 
• In a high-intensity final, **India** secured a convincing victory over **Nepal** with a scoreline of **54-36**. The Indian side dominated both innings to ensure the gold medal in the first-ever global edition of this indigenous sport.
 
• The tournament was organized by the **Kho-Kho Federation of India (KKFI)** in collaboration with the **International Kho-Kho Federation**, marking a significant milestone in taking the traditional sport to a global audience.
 
• The **men’s team** performance was characterized by exceptional speed and defensive tactics, which proved too much for the **Nepalese** side, who finished as the **runners-up** with the silver medal.
